top_signals.title: EU states revive plan to use frozen Russian assets for Ukraine
top_signals.summary: Sweden, the Netherlands and Spain push to use the funds to solve Kyiv’s latest funding crisis
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Army seeks 8,000 new short-range missiles per year
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Army wants to purchase up to 8,000 new short-range missiles per year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Novak Djokovic’s endurance could face grueling test at U.S. Open
top_signals.summary: Another title at Flushing Meadows would take the Serbian beyond Margaret Court's 24 Grand Slam singles crowns and give him sole possession of the all-time record.

top_signals.title: Meta pledges to overhaul kids’ safety protections, pay $17 billion to settle social media case
top_signals.summary: A multibillion-dollar settlement with attorneys general from nearly every U.S. state and territory will mean new privacy and safety protections in Meta products.
